posts.title: How Siemens Uses ARC-1 for SAP Development and Analysis
posts.description: Before I change an ABAP method, I want to know what else calls it. In SAP, I’d open the where-used list. At Siemens, a developer can ask an AI assistant the same question. ARC-1 lets it look up the answer using that developer’s own SAP permissions. posts.title: ARC-1 and SAP ADT: Growing Together
posts.description: When I started ARC-1 , there were already MCP servers for SAP’s ADT APIs. My main goal was enterprise-ready access: a service hosted on SAP BTP, with central control over who can use it and what they are allowed to do.
